name: Architectural asphalt shingles
description: Laminated (architectural) fiberglass asphalt shingles, 3 bundles per 100 sq ft square.
source: CertainTeed Landmark technical data: 217–229 lb per square (100 sq ft), by plant

name: Corrugated metal roofing (29 ga)
description: 29 gauge galvalume or galvanized corrugated steel panels, screwed through the ribs.
source: Metal Sales Classic Rib section properties, 29 ga: 0.63 psf

name: Standing-seam metal roofing (24 ga)
description: 24 gauge painted steel standing-seam panels with concealed clips.
source: Metal Sales Snap-Loc 24 product data, 24 ga: 1.14 psf

name: Synthetic roof underlayment
description: Woven polypropylene roof underlayment under shingles or metal.
source: GAF FeltBuster data sheet: 23 lb per 1,000 sq ft roll (0.023 psf)

name: Aluminum drip edge
description: Pre-finished aluminum drip edge at eaves and rakes, 10ft lengths.
source: Approximate: computed for 0.019in aluminum sheet at 169 pcf (no published weight); 5in K-style gutter in 0.027in stock is about 0.38 lb/ft

name: 5in K-style aluminum gutter
description: 5in K-style seamless or sectional aluminum gutter with hangers.
source: Approximate: computed for 0.019in aluminum sheet at 169 pcf (no published weight); 5in K-style gutter in 0.027in stock is about 0.38 lb/ft

name: 2x3 aluminum downspout
source: Approximate: computed for 0.019in aluminum sheet at 169 pcf (no published weight); 5in K-style gutter in 0.027in stock is about 0.38 lb/ft

name: Clear corrugated polycarbonate panels
description: Clear corrugated polycarbonate panels, 26in wide (Palram Suntuf class), for patio covers and greenhouses. Fasten with the maker's EPDM-washered screws through closure strips on purlins at 24in (36in max); Palram's minimum slope is 1-1/2in in 12 (about 7 degrees).
source: Palram Suntuf installation guide F1409 (11.27.2018): minimum recommended slope 1-1/2in in 12, purlins no more than 36in apart with 24in recommended, Palram EPDM-washered fasteners only, closure strips under fasteners at purlins. Weight: Suntuf 26in x 12ft clear (101699), 6.4 lb per panel (Arbor Home, DK Hardware listings) over 26 sq ft = 0.246 psf; Palram publishes no weight

name: Clay roof tile
description: Fired clay roof tile (mission barrel or flat), about 12 psf installed. Heavy: the rafters and roof framing must be sized for it.
source: Ludowici product pages: Straight Barrel Mission 16in 1,190 lb per square (11.9 psf); LudoShake 598, Greenwich 1,575, Rustic Colonial 1,800 lb per square

name: Concrete roof tile
description: Standard-weight concrete roof tile (Eagle Roofing class), about 10 psf installed. Heavy: the rafters and roof framing must be sized for it.
source: Eagle Roofing 2026 Tech Specs: Bel Air, Golden Eagle, Ponderosa, Sequoia, Tapered Slate about 970 lb per square installed (9.7 psf); Eaglelite lightweight 720

name: EPDM rubber roof membrane (60 mil)
description: 60 mil EPDM rubber membrane for low-slope roofs, fully adhered or mechanically fastened with seam tape. Not for steep-slope roofs; follow the maker's minimum slope and edge details.
source: Carlisle Sure-Seal EPDM (Kleen, non-reinforced) product data: 45 mil 0.29, 60 mil 0.39, 90 mil 0.59 lb/sq ft

name: TPO roof membrane (60 mil)
description: 60 mil white TPO single-ply membrane for low-slope roofs, heat-welded seams. Usually installed by a roofing contractor with a hot-air welder.
source: GAF EverGuard Extreme TPO 60 mil data sheet: 10 x 100ft roll (1,000 sq ft) weighs 322 lb = 0.322 psf

name: Shingle-over ridge vent
description: Shingle-over plastic ridge vent in 4ft sections (GAF Cobra / Air Vent ShingleVent II class), capped with ridge shingles. Needs a matching intake vent area at the eaves.
source: Air Vent shingle-over ridge vent 84719, 7/8 x 12 x 48in, 2.25 lb (DK Hardware listing) = 0.5625 psf over its 4 sq ft; ShingleVent II is 12 x 48 x 0.88in (Do it Best), weight not published
